feeds.title: Eagle Technology Blog
feeds.description: When Trevor and Corallie Eagle founded what was to become Eagle Technology in 1969, their vision was for a family company that would bring excellence in IT products and services to the New Zealand market. Today, Duane Eagle, Managing Director, remains committed to that vision and heads up an organisation that has grown to include 120 staff whilst retaining its family ownership and core values. All of Trevor and Corallie's seven children worked within the company at some time; Today, Duane Eagle continues the legacy started by Trevor and Corallie more than fifty years ago.
